items.title: 1.2 Jadeed periodic table: khusoosiyat aur ahmiyat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.2, printed page 3.

blocks.text: Jadeed (modern) periodic table mein anasir ki darja-bandi un ki khusoosiyat samajhna asaan banati hai. Is ki bari khusoosiyat yeh hain.

items: 118 anasir apne atomic numbers ki barhti tarteeb mein rakhe gaye hain.
Saat ufqi (horizontal) qatarein hain, periods, aur atharah amoodi columns, groups. Table ke purane editions mein amoodi groups aath A groups aur das B groups mein batte the.

Ek hi group ke anasir milti-julti kimiyai khusoosiyat dikhate hain kyunke un ke valence electrons ki tadaad ek jaisi hai, magar group mein oopar se neeche un ki tabee khusoosiyat batadreej badalti hain.
Ek period ke anasir baen se daen jate hue khusoosiyat mein batadreej tabdeeli dikhate hain.

blocks.text: Groups aur periods ke ilawa samajh behtar karne ke liye anasir ko blocks, families aur categories mein bhi baanta jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Chlorine aur bromine ek hi group mein hain; chlorine aur argon ek hi period mein. Kis jore ki kimiyai khusoosiyat milti-julti hain, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Chlorine aur bromine, kyunke ek group ke anasir ke valence electrons ki tadaad ek jaisi hai, jo kimiyai rawaiya tai karti hai; un ki tabee khusoosiyat group mein sirf batadreej badalti hain. Chlorine aur argon ek period mein hain, jahan khusoosiyat baen se daen qadam ba qadam badalti hain, to woh saaf mukhtalif hain.

items: 118 anasir atomic number ki tarteeb mein; 7 periods aur 18 groups (purane tables: 8 A aur 10 B groups).

Ek group: ek jaise valence electrons, milti-julti chemistry, tabee khusoosiyat mein batadreej tabdeeli. Ek period: baen se daen batadreej tabdeeli. Blocks, families aur categories izafi girohbandi hain.
